comparison.objective: Connect booster cables in a safe jump-start order; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Open sprung clamps, align them around tapered posts/stud, release them to bite, and manage deformable leads, versus fine socket torque and collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Four spring-held connections must be made in the prescribed polarity/order with no forbidden contact; candidate requires lockout-safe adjustment and two compliant carriage cycles.
comparison.reason: Both require safety sequencing, but electrical clamp placement and polarity management do not test damping adjustment or response calibration.
